decidedOption: show the bound delivery shape as a one-word badge beside the effort size on the existing backlog row, only when a live Workroom carries one, instead of a new column, filter or detail panel

notes.routeMeasurement: route-budget-baseline.json adjudicates /ops as a whole, never a single row, so the numbers come from rendering BacklogItemRow with the fixture in apps/web/components/ops/BacklogItemRow.uxbudget.test.tsx (an in-progress item whose live Workroom is bound to delivery-break-fix@1.0.0, the heaviest badge) and measuring with lib/ux-budget's measureUxBudget plus axe-core. The same test renders the unshaped row as the comparison: 33 visible words, 3 sub-legible controls, reading grade 2.7. The badge adds one word (BF), no control, and no sub-legible control; the three sub-legible controls are the row's pre-existing icon buttons.
notes.fit: Design 2026-09-02 §3.3: the shape a Workroom declared at the claim is visible where the work is. The row already carries effort size and Workroom ownership as compact chips; the shape joins them as one more chip on the type scale (text-dpf-caption), titled with its shape name, and is absent when no live room carries a shape. No new navigation, form, control, or primary action.
notes.failureState: An item with no live shaped Workroom renders exactly as before; a room bound to a non-delivery shape shows nothing extra.
notes.theme: No new styles; the existing chip treatment with the semantic tone tokens (--dpf-error/success/info/warning) is reused.
